title: Causal Chain Audit: Which Node Intervention Has the Best Safety/Utility Tradeoff?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Compelling chain: implement five interventions -> compare safety improvement vs. utility cost -> rank by tradeoff. Directly produces actionable guidance for practitioners. Intermediate results (each intervention's individual effect) are independently valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing five separate interventions (task specification, decomposition, delegation scoping, pre-execution tripwire, post-incident protocol), running all individually and in combination on 20 tasks. This is a massive engineering undertaking far beyond beginner capability in 30 hours.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five interventions tested individually and in combination on 20 tasks is an entire research program, not a scoped project. No clear single first deliverable that stands alone; the value is in the comparison across all five.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
